limitations: Road/path data and loaded ground are still required.
Four-contact fitting cannot bridge an arbitrary cliff or non-supporting terrain; validated start fallback or waiting is used.
Farm controls constant requested speed while active on validated ground; pause/brake, lost ownership, missing ground and server corrections can interrupt it.
Cool mode is assisted kinematic driving, not an unmodified tyre simulation.
Repeated local area farming can receive the game same-spot payout penalty. No reward remotes are called.
